rationale.org-governance: Integrates policies, audit logs, accountability, and change control across SDLC.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Requires persistent, versioned interaction records linked to human review decisions.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Provides citations, traces, and counterfactual views supporting reviewer judgment.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Makes tests, linters, detectors, and verification passes auditable pipeline controls.
rationale.regulatory-compliance: Maps interaction artifacts and escalation records to EU AI Act expectations.
rationale.lit-review: Synthesizes forty studies through a focused rapid-review protocol.
rationale.framework: Delivers a reusable capability model and reporting architecture for toolchains.
rationale.design-only: Specifies detailed capabilities and interfaces without implementing an executable artifact.
rationale.steering: Centrally governs prompts, context bindings, retrieval scope, and generation constraints.
rationale.metrics: Defines compliance, privacy, bias, and ip-plagiarism measures for reporting.
rationale.agentic: Addresses artifact-level, semi-automated workflows reviewed through PR and CI gates.
rationale.risk-security: Specifies adversarial-prompt tests, security checks, and escalation safeguards.
rationale.risk-overreliance: Mitigates over-reliance through evidence surfaces and measured reviewer decisions.
rationale.risk-ip: Substantively specifies licensing, attribution checks, provenance, and escalation.
rationale.risk-bias: Develops fairness controls, monitoring thresholds, and model-level escalation boundaries.
